steps.context: general rotation (PRE-2026-06 NERF — see gap note)
steps.text: Press V to hit the front line, press 2 to hit the back line and apply a debuff, then reposition to keep DPS up. Try to NOT use spell 1 — use V instead (less ammo consumption, more spread).
If the enemy blob has flamers/Zykalian units of their own, ignore the above priority and try to snipe them with spell 2 as a hard priority.

Be careful about musket liquid fire, divers, and fire-rune interactions. ALWAYS cycle V and 2 — playing Zykalian from far away using only spell 2 loses 50% of the unit's potential damage. ALWAYS X-move after shooting — don't stand still.
